raw.rationale: Pinitol is a weak, non-selective natural product with no established gamma-secretase inhibitory potency at 2.5 µM, and PRISM single-concentration data generally show few lineage-selective viability effects for such compounds; any apparent selectivity would be rare and lineage-dependent. Thus probabilities are low across all lineages, with slight elevation only for lineages where Notch/gamma-secretase dependency is more common (e.g., CNS, breast, colorectal).
